native_contract: 159-instruction input path: first decays kind 4/6 activation timers, updates hover/countdown and hit coordinates, gates on the word at buttons+count*0x24+8 and current mouse flags, selects first enabled/pressed record, clears radio peers for kind 2, stores parameters, dispatches the correct left/right token, and returns change or one-based selection. The zero-return callee 0x0047D350 has no side effects and its result is discarded.
reuse_review: Reuses generated/mixed/runtime/SmallButtonInput.c algorithm after replacing absolute addresses with typed record/state fields; its 0x00425B50/0x00425B80 leaf owners are included and mapped. direct_c/MenuInputTestBoundaries.c contains traps only.
limitations: The three indirect action calls remain the caller-owned token dispatcher. trailing_trigger must be the actual adjacent native record word; no default is synthesized.
